subject.title: fix(gateway): allow Gemini CLI image-capable models

question: Should the stale-row repair remain a narrow legacy fallback in the shared Gateway resolver, or should Google provider normalization own this capability before the Gateway gate runs?
rationale: The branch proves the user-facing repair, but repository policy prefers provider-owned behavior and current main now has dynamic Google model resolution; only maintainers can confirm whether stale persisted catalog rows require another shared legacy shim.

options.title: Land the focused Gateway fallback
options.body: Rebase the branch, remove unrelated formatting churn, and retain the proven Pro/Flash-only matcher as a legacy stale-row safety net.

options.title: Move capability normalization to Google
options.body: Repair stale and missing Gemini CLI capability metadata in the Google plugin so the shared Gateway resolver remains provider-agnostic.

options.title: Pause for a generic capability seam
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and defer this branch until a provider-neutral override contract can replace provider-specific Gateway shims.

recommendation.title: Land the focused Gateway fallback
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, remove unrelated formatting churn, and retain the proven Pro/Flash-only matcher as a legacy stale-row safety net.

likelyOwner.reason: They already repaired and validated this branch directly and are best positioned to choose whether to finish that landing path or redirect ownership.
